Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents (arXiv 2308.03688v1) · paper method: AgentBench's overall score averages heterogeneous task metrics after weighting each by the reciprocal of its mean across the evaluated models.

cohort2.claim.agentbench.heterogeneous-weighted-score

  • The aggregate is population-dependent normalization, not percent of all tasks completed.
  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
  • Version-specific paper report; no experiment or dataset record inspection was reproduced by this author.
  • AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as AgentsLocator: Physical PDF pp13,14; 4.1 Overall Score Calculation; excerpt at physical p14, pdftotext-layout line 48 (1-based).
